patch.summary:
Choose Greenhouse only if your buying job matches “Structured-hiring ATS (Core / Plus / Pro) — custom quote by plan, hiring volume, and org c” rather than Workday's shape. Choose Workday only if your buying job matches “Enterprise HCM default — custom PEPM quote (no published seat $); implementation-led. Land” rather than Greenhouse's shape. Workflow advantage: Greenhouse leans recruiting-ats; Workday leans enterprise-hcm. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Greenhouse is Structured-hiring ATS (Core / Plus / Pro) — custom quote by plan, hiring volume, and org complexity; no published seat dollars.; Workday is Enterprise HCM default — custom PEPM quote (no published seat $); implementation-led. Landscape only vs SMB HRIS/payroll..
- Workflow coverage skew: Greenhouse-leaning recruiting-ats vs Workday-leaning enterprise-hcm.
- Researched limits: Greenhouse — No published list price — quotes scale with hiring volume and complexity, not recruiter seats alone; Workday — No published list price — PEPM and implementation are opaque.

Limitations — Greenhouse: No published list price — quotes scale with hiring volume and complexity, not recruiter seats alone; Implementation and onboarding modules are often separate commercially; Workday: No published list price — PEPM and implementation are opaque; Multi-month implementations and SI partners are typical.
